Definition: to make an errand, i.e. betake oneself
BiblicalUsage: tsâyar is used for to make an errand. It appears once, in Joshua 9:4.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe tsâyar reminds me that God's Word is exact down to the word, not only in the great themes.
